title: Endless Ocean 2: Adventures of the Deep
subtitle: The next dive reaches further

body: Endless Ocean 2: Adventures of the Deep is Arika's Wii diving sequel, released in North America as Endless Ocean: Blue World. Its journey expands beyond the original game's sea to destinations around the world, including polar and freshwater environments. Exploring, identifying animals and recovering objects remain central activities, now connected with a larger range of places and a continuing story. The change gives the diving routine more variety: preparing for a particular destination also means considering the different creatures and conditions that may be encountered below its surface.

Some creatures can now pose a danger, and the Pulsar provides a way to calm them through electrical charges. The same tool can help sick or injured animals, giving it a role beyond protecting the diver. Oxygen and equipment also affect the practical limits of an expedition. Salvaged objects can be sold to finance upgrades and other purchases. These additions give preparation a clearer place in the adventure, connecting what is found during one dive with the equipment and opportunities available when setting out on the next one.

The aquarium returns with areas for different kinds of wildlife, including smaller creatures and species associated with the shore. Dolphins can again become companions, and the diver can ride them to move through the water. A private reef and island decorations provide other ways to shape the spaces visited between expeditions. These activities give discoveries a home outside the moment of identification. The player can return from a distant location with more than a completed route, gradually building a collection of animals, objects and places that records the longer journey.
